about.heading: About us
about.intro: We are a group of dog lovers who believe in the power of shared walks.
about.missionText: PawMeet was born from the idea that walking your dog can be so much more than a simple daily routine. We want to create real connections between people through a shared love for our four-legged friends.
about.whyText: Every day millions of dog owners go out for a walk. Often the same routes, the same times, the same habits. PawMeet transforms this routine into an opportunity to socialize, explore new paths, and let our dogs have fun with new playmates.
about.teamText: We are a small team of developers, designers, and above all, dog owners. Every feature we build comes from a real need we have experienced firsthand.
